ITEM 1 | Pale golden-brown granular grain, loose and fluffy, individual grains about 2-3 mm, dry with no sheen, spread in a mound across the lower-left of the plate, roughly 9 cm by 7 cm and about 2 cm tall at its peak, with a few small crumbs scattered beside it | 110

ITEM 2 | Flaked white fish-like pieces, moist and slightly translucent with a glossy surface, some browned edges, pieces about 3-4 cm long and 1-1.5 cm thick, sitting in the upper-center of the plate and partly over the grain, with a few darker flecked bits and small green herb pieces mixed in | 85

ITEM 3 | Bright green, slender stalks with a smooth, slightly glossy surface and some thin leaves, about 0.5 cm thick and 8-10 cm long, arranged in a loose tangle diagonally across the center of the plate, some ends curled and a few pieces lying over the grain | 45

ITEM 4 | Dark green, ruffled leafy greens with crinkled edges and a matte surface, some lighter green veined stems, forming a loose heap about 10 cm by 8 cm and 2 cm tall on the right side of the plate, with slight moisture and a few small darker flecks | 70

ITEM 5 | Small, scattered dark green leafy fragments, wilted and matte, about 0.5-1 cm each, lying near the top of the fish and between the stalks, plus one small dark brown fragment on the right edge of the greens | 8
